TILE SUPPLY
We supply the complete system, or we lay tiles the customer buys themselves — the labour rate is
the same either way. Our own range runs from Classic White Ceramic 300x600 at $32 per m2 up to
Premium Marble Mosaic at $125 per m2.

THE REST
All prices include GST. Based in Pakenham, we travel 25km.
Minimum job charge $350. Site inspection $95. Travel outside our standard area $75.
Not included: plumbing, electrical, shower screens, asbestos removal, structural repairs.
Workmanship warranty as per contract.
